releaseTitle: Hotspot Manager v1.10.0 - Enterprise Flow Control + Live Topology + MikroPilot Theme
releaseNotes:
• 🛡️ FLOW CONTROL v2 (Ruijie-style categories): 32 services across 8 groups — Social Media, Communications (Telegram/WhatsApp/Viber/Skype/Discord/WeChat/Zoom), Video Streaming, VPN & Proxies (VPN/Tor/Psiphon/Shadowsocks), Gambling (betting + lottery), Adult Content, Banking & Finance, Gaming (PUBG/Free Fire/MLBB/Clash/Valorant/Roblox/Garena)
• 📡 NETWORK TOPOLOGY modern look: animated flowing data beams, pulsing health dots, signal-strength meters + drill-down health strip in AP details
• 🎨 Full MikroPilot-style dark enterprise dashboard theme (deep-space navy + electric cyan + emerald revenue accents)
• 🖥️ 10 self-contained Portal Theme HTML template sets (login/status/logout/alogin/errors) generated into portal_templates/, deployable from the app and VPS
• 🔗 Theme deploy writes hotspot/.portal_theme marker — VPS enforcer syncs the matching template automatically
• 🔧 v1.9.x fixes preserved: V3 quota/time enforcement, crash fixes, CPU-safe enforcer

Install over v1.9.2 — same signature, no uninstall.
